items.title: Monday Morning Quarterback:  Sac State finally has a signature win
items.summary: Sacramento State’s win over Kent State was more than its first FBS and MAC victory. It gave the Hornets a defensive identity, leaned into Isaiah Ene as a cornerstone and provided head coach Alonzo Carter’s staff with the kind of tape that can sell recruits on the program’s future.

items.title: FOOTBALL PLAYS FINAL HOME GAME ON WEDNESDAY AGAINST TOLEDO
items.summary: For the first time in school history, Sacramento State will get a taste of MACtion as the Hornets welcome Toledo on Wednesday, Nov. 4, at 4 p.m. PT. The game will be the last one at Hornet Stadium this season.

items.title: Won for the record books:  Sac State gets historic first MAC win
items.summary: Sacramento State dominated Kent State by a score 31-10 on Friday, Oct. 30, 2026. The win broke a long losing streak, and saw the Hornets get the historic first Mid-American Conference win that has been eluding them.

items.title: FOOTBALL CLAIMS FIRST MAC WIN WITH 31-10 VICTORY OVER KENT STATE
items.summary: Isaiah Ene rushed for a career-high 107 yards and the Sacramento State defense recorded five takeaways to lift the team to a 31-10 victory over Kent State on Friday night at Hornet Stadium.

items.title: FIVE FACTS FOR FOOTBALL VS. KENT STATE ON FRIDAY NIGHT
items.summary: All you need to know prior to tonight's game against Kent State.

items.title: Catch me if you can: Sac State looks to speed past Kent State
items.summary: Sacramento State football looks to earn its first win in the MAC during its inaugural season. The Hornets will look to establish their offense at home while continuing to force turnovers on defense to give themselves the best chance against Kent State.

items.title: FOOTBALL TAKES ON KENT STATE ON FRIDAY NIGHT
items.summary: Friday night lights return to Hornet Stadium on Oct. 30 when Sacramento State will face Kent State for the first time. The game will kickoff in front of a national television audience at 7:30 p.m. PT.

items.title: Monday Morning Quarterback:  Sac State shows progress, but familiar problems persist against Ball State
items.summary: Sacramento State showed signs of improvement in its 34-17 loss to Ball State, particularly on the ground. This week’s Monday Morning Quarterback examines Isaiah Ene’s emergence, the secondary’s struggles against explosive plays and another difficult outing defending a mobile quarterback.

items.title: FOOTBALL SEES BALL STATE PULL AWAY IN SECOND HALF IN 34-17 LOSS
items.summary: Jackson Sharman threw two touchdown passes and Boogsie Silvera had a pair of interceptions but Sacramento State could not contain Ball State quarterback Keldric Luster in a 34-17 loss on Saturday afternoon at Scheumann Stadium.

items.title: FIVE FACTS FOR FOOTBALL AT BALL STATE
items.summary: Sacramento State and Ball State will meet for the first time in football on Saturday in Muncie, Ind.

items.title: FOOTBALL PLAYS AT BALL STATE ON SATURDAY AFTERNOON
items.summary: Sacramento State will visit another new team as the Hornets play at Ball State will meet for the first time on Saturday, Oct. 24, in Muncie, Ind. The game kicks off at 12:30 p.m. PT from Scheumann Stadium.

items.title: FOOTBALL SUFFERS LOSS TO OHIO ON HOMECOMING
items.summary: Ohio remained unbeaten in the MAC and spoiled Homecoming for Sacramento State with a 48-7 win at Hornet Stadium on Saturday night.

items.title: VISIT THE HORNET EXCHANGE!
items.summary: Sacramento State Athletics has launched the Hornet Exchange — a program designed to help student-athletes benefit from their name, image and likeness — it was announced today.
